description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing and manipulating RuleNodeDebugEvent entities in a SQL database, including custom queries for retrieving, filtering, and deleting debug events related to rule nodes in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: RuleNodeDebugEventRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for RuleNodeDebugEventEntity, providing methods for querying and deleting rule node debug events with various filters.

methods.name: findLatestEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the latest rule node debug events for a specific tenant and entity, limited by the specified number.

methods.name: findLatestDebugRuleNodeInEvent
methods.description: Finds the most recent 'IN' type debug event for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: findEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of rule node debug events filtered by tenant, entity, time range, and other optional parameters.

methods.name: removeEvents
methods.description: Deletes rule node debug events for a specific tenant and entity within a specified time range.
